items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I knew them not too very well

ctx.x: Well, how much were music jobs paying generally during the Depression?

During the Depression generally? Yeah. Down a quarter was the top price, most places. Yeah. I mean, now and then you get a special affair for two dollars a night. Oh, I know you know Sam Nicholson. Oh, yeah. Sam and his brother. Well, uh... Get the whole player. Phillip. Phillip. Phillip. Well, listen, it's just, those Nicholson, I mean, I knew them not too very well, but they related to Albert Nichols. No, no. Because Albert Nicholson was... That was Nicholson. Oh, Nicholson. Sam Nicholson. And, uh... His…
Nickerson and his brother, he did talk with his college man. That was Nickerson.
